newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian accountants call for fraud office.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian accountants call for fraud office.

text.p: Nigerian accountants have called on the military government to set up a serious fraud office to hunt down fraudsters who have soiled Nigeria's image.

"We are not talking about street-wise fraud but sophisticated maneouvring of professionals, therefore you need professionals to crack it," Emmanuel Ijewere, president of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Nigeria, told reporters at the weekend after a conference on fraud in the capital Abuja.
The institute said the office should be set up as part of military ruler General Sani Abacha's "Vision 2010" economic plan into the next century, which is still under discussion.
Nigeria has a reputation as the home of "advance fee fraud", in which businessmen, usually foreigners, are encouraged to part with sums of money for shady deals which later turn out to non-existent.
